I read the full six-file diff and issue #2701. I checked the laws from upstream/main, not from the PR branch. The template states no invented limit or condition. Both registry entries exist. The tests prove that an unstated condition refuses the cut and that a synthetic condition permits posting.

`example_catalog` passed in 41 seconds. Its four existing ignored tests did not run. The earlier timeout did not repeat.

**Extra suites run:**

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test machine_library`: 17 passed.
- Both new template tests and the existing COMP and taper/4-axis/lean refusal tests ran again by name: four passed.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-app -- -D warnings`: passed.
- All five light-test steps ran with `cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light' --only 'app light'`: 11 tests passed. This includes motion lib (seven), island, neck, parallel pocket, and app pocket-pass-start (one each). Each step built its own release target. No full heavy lane ran.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests`: 104 tests ran, with three failures and eleven errors. The same command on bare upstream main produced the same failures and errors. The failures are the two rotary icon copies and the missing `manualToolChange` reference row. The errors are missing `zola` and `node`. These are baseline or host problems, not PR regressions. No exact tracking issue was identified; #4133 tracks broader site-test reliability.

The first light run was void because my site-test command created Python cache directories during it. I removed those generated files and reran all five light steps. The second run passed with a clean working tree.

**Safety and goldens:** No post script, generator, geometry, simulation, or collision logic changes. No recorded program or golden moves. The G-EDM golden and conformance suites pass unchanged. I also reran the input-mutation refusal cases: injected COMP and taper/4-axis/lean inputs refuse by name. The clean controls pass. These are input mutations; no source mutation was made or claimed. A real G-EDM controller was not tested.

No UI files change, so before/after UI screenshots do not apply. The worktree and `review-4312` branch remain in place. The PR labels, title, and draft state remain unchanged. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Please mark this PR ready with `gh pr ready 4312 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` so it can merge on this review at the next cut.
